question: Cross-checking against the Public Health Engineering Dept, Gujarat, how many works have no client reference letter on file?
cypher:
MATCH (w:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(c:Client)
WHERE c.name = 'Public Health Engineering Dept, Gujarat'
AND NOT (w)-[:HAS_REFERENCE]->(:Document)
RETURN COUNT(w) AS works_without_client_reference

question: Jal Nigam, Jharkhand — I’m pretty sure we only have reference letters for one of their projects, but am I right in thinking how many of their completed works actually lack a client reference letter on file?
cypher:
MATCH (w:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(c:Client)
WHERE c.name = 'Jal Nigam, Jharkhand'
RETURN COUNT(w) - COUNT( (w)-[:HAS_REFERENCE]->() ) AS works_without_reference

question: Cross-checking the completion date against Asha Nair's PMP for 2021-03-10, what number of days passed from issuance to finish for School Building — Madhya Pradesh Pkg-145?
cypher:
MATCH (work:Work {title: "School Building — Madhya Pradesh Pkg-145"})-[:HAS_REFERENCE]->(doc:Document)
MATCH (p:Person {name: "Asha Nair"})-[:HOLDS]->(cred:Credential {kind: "PMP"})
WHERE cred.issued = "2021-03-10"
RETURN TOInteger(work.completed_day) - TOInteger(cred.issued_day) AS days_passed

question: To ensure the audit documentation reflects the official timeline, what is the exact interval from Chandan Banerjee's March 10, 2021 PMP issuance to the completion of the WTP Augmentation project in West Bengal Package 51?
cypher:
MATCH (p:Person {name: "Chandan Banerjee"})-[:HOLDS]->(cred:Credential {kind: "PMP"})
MATCH (w:Work {title: "WTP Augmentation project in West Bengal Package 51"})
RETURN 
  cred.issued AS pmp_issuance_date,
  w.completed AS project_completion_date,
  toInteger(w.completed[0..4]) * 365 + toInteger(right(w.completed, 2)) - 
  toInteger(cred.issued[0..4]) * 365 - toInteger(right(cred.issued, 2)) AS approx_days_interval

question: How many different categories of work has Chandan Banerjee led to completion under his PMP certification?
cypher:
MATCH (p:Person {name: "Chandan Banerjee"})-[:HOLDS]->(c:Credential {kind: "PMP"})
MATCH (w:Work)-[:LED_BY]->(p)
WHERE w.completed IS NOT NULL
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT w.category) AS category_count

question: Asha Nair's PMP project portfolio shows several completed assignments; how many distinct work classifications has she successfully delivered?
cypher:
MATCH (p:Person {name: "Asha Nair"})-[:HOLDS]->(:Credential {kind: "PMP"})
MATCH (p)<-[:LED_BY]-(w:Work)
WHERE w.completed IS NOT NULL
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT w.category) AS distinct_work_classifications

question: Starting from Rahul Menon’s PMP certification (PMI-200029) for the Ring Road — Maharashtra Pkg-125, what is the combined value of every completed assignment he has delivered for the Public Works Department, Govt of Maharashtra?
cypher:
MATCH (p:Person {name: "Rahul Menon"})-[:HOLDS]->(c:Credential {kind: "PMP", issued: "PMI-200029"})
MATCH (p)-[:LED_BY]->(w:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(cl:Client)
WHERE w.title = "Ring Road — Maharashtra Pkg-125" AND cl.name = "Public Works Department" AND cl.govt_level = "state" AND cl.state = "Maharashtra" AND w.completed IS NOT NULL
RETURN SUM(w.value) AS total_value

question: Could you please calculate the total value of all completed assignments Neha Chopra has delivered for Lakshya Engineering & Construction, referencing her PMP certification (PMI-200006) and the Residential Quarters — West Bengal Pkg-67 project as the reference point?
cypher:
MATCH (p:Person {name: "Neha Chopra"})-[:HOLDS]->(cred:Credential {kind: "PMP", issued: "PMI-200006"})
MATCH (p)-[:LED_BY]->(w:Work {title: "Residential Quarters — West Bengal Pkg-67"})
MATCH (w)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(client:Client {name: "Lakshya Engineering & Construction"})
MATCH (p)-[:LED_BY]->(otherWorks:Work)
WHERE otherWorks.completed IS NOT NULL
RETURN SUM(otherWorks.value) AS total_value

question: Gautam Joshi’s PMP issued March 10, 2021, what’s the combined value of only the projects he led that wrapped up after that date, needed immediately for the bid cutoff?
cypher:
MATCH (p:Person {name: "Gautam Joshi"})-[:HOLDS]->(cred:Credential {kind: "PMP"})
WHERE cred.issued = "2021-03-10"
MATCH (p)-[:LED_BY]->(w:Work)
WHERE w.completed > "2021-03-10"
RETURN SUM(w.value) AS total_value

question: Could you please calculate the combined value of the works Asha Nair led that were completed after her PMP certification date of March 10, 2021?
cypher:
MATCH (p:Person {name: "Asha Nair"})-[:HOLDS]->(cred:Credential {kind: "PMP"})
MATCH (p)-[:LED_BY]->(w:Work)
WHERE w.completed > cred.issued
RETURN SUM(w.value) AS combined_value

question: Regarding Asha Nair’s PMP work on the Cable Stayed Bridge — Jharkhand Pkg-115, what is the defensible average size across all completed projects for the commissioning client?
cypher:
MATCH (p:Person {name: "Asha Nair"})-[:HOLDS]->(cred:Credential {kind: "PMP"})
MATCH (p)-[:LED_BY]->(w:Work {title: "Cable Stayed Bridge — Jharkhand Pkg-115"})
MATCH (w)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(client:Client)
MATCH (c:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(client)
WHERE c.completed IS NOT NULL
RETURN AVG(c.value) AS average_project_size

question: Cross-checking Naveen Roy's PMP for Check Dam — Gujarat Pkg-62, what is the mean size across projects for the client?
cypher:
MATCH (p:Person {name: "Naveen Roy"})-[:HOLDS]->(c:Credential {kind: "PMP"})
MATCH (w:Work {title: "Check Dam — Gujarat Pkg-62"})-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(client:Client)
MATCH (otherWorks:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(client)
RETURN avg(TOInteger(otherWorks.value)) AS mean_value

question: Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of West Bengal; excluding buildings, what is the precise aggregate value of every project we have delivered for them?
cypher:
MATCH (w:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(c:Client)
WHERE c.name = 'Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of West Bengal' AND NOT w.category = 'Buildings'
RETURN SUM(w.value) AS total_value

question: Jharkhand Municipal Corporation; excluding roads maintenance, what’s the combined value of our completed assignments for them before we lock this bid?
cypher:
MATCH (w:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(c:Client {name: "Jharkhand Municipal Corporation"})
WHERE w.state = "completed" AND NOT w.category = "roads maintenance"
RETURN SUM(w.value) AS total_value

question: Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of Uttar Pradesh is the account under review, so how much additional work must we secure to reach our credential target of INR 20 Cr?
cypher:
MATCH (c:Client {name: "Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of Uttar Pradesh"})
MATCH (w:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(c)
WITH SUM(w.value) AS current_value
RETURN 200000000 - current_value AS additional_work_needed

question: Jal Nigam, Jharkhand, by how much does the largest completed work exceed the second largest?
cypher:
MATCH (w:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(c:Client)
WHERE c.name = 'Jal Nigam' AND c.state = 'Jharkhand' AND w.completed IS NOT NULL
WITH w.value AS value
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 2
WITH collect(value) AS topValues
RETURN topValues[0] - topValues[1] AS difference

question: Jharkhand Municipal Corporation, cross-checking against the portal, what is the difference between the largest work value and the second largest?
cypher:
MATCH (w:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(c:Client)
WHERE c.name = "Jharkhand Municipal Corporation"
WITH w, toInteger(w.value) AS value
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 2
WITH collect(value) AS top_values
RETURN top_values[0] - top_values[1] AS difference

question: Jal Nigam, Jharkhand is our starting point for the audit, so what whole number out of one hundred represents the defensible share of completed assignments that carry formal verification on file?
cypher:
MATCH (w:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(c:Client)
WHERE c.name = 'Jal Nigam, Jharkhand'
OPTIONAL MATCH (w)-[:HAS_REFERENCE]->(d:Document)
WITH COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.doc_id IS NOT NULL THEN w END) AS verified_works, COUNT(w) AS total_works
RETURN CASE WHEN total_works = 0 THEN 0 ELSE toInteger(100 * verified_works / total_works) END AS defensible_share

question: Jharkhand Municipal Corporation is where I am cross-checking our engagement history, so what number out of one hundred represents the count of assignments for that client that carry a reference letter divided by the total?
cypher:
MATCH (w:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(c:Client)
WHERE c.name = 'Jharkhand Municipal Corporation'
WITH COUNT(w) AS total_assignments,
     COUNT((w)-[:HAS_REFERENCE]->()) AS referenced_assignments
RETURN toFloat(referenced_assignments) / total_assignments * 100 AS percentage_referenced

question: Jal Nigam, Jharkhand, what’s the combined value of their works crossing the seventy-three crore mark so I can lock the bid before the deadline?
cypher:
MATCH (w:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(c:Client)
WHERE c.name = 'Jal Nigam' AND c.state = 'Jharkhand' AND w.value > 73000000
RETURN SUM(w.value) AS combined_value_above_73_crore

question: Maharashtra Municipal Corporation, what’s the aggregate of their contracts hitting the six crore line so I can lock the pricing before the cutoff?
cypher:
MATCH (c:Client)-[:FOR_CLIENT]-(contract:Contract)
WHERE c.name = 'Maharashtra Municipal Corporation'
AND contract.awarded_value >= 6000000
RETURN SUM(contract.awarded_value) AS aggregate_value
